A result/material carrier need not predict unchanged subsequent action rates in general. A contrast can compare explicitly fixed statistical models, but cannot refute the entire semantic category.

Supply independently justified boundaries and action/continuation annotations for the semantic claim, without assigning local-step closure solely from inherited position. Exploratory structural analyses remain possible with a narrower claim ceiling.
